description: Scala source code defining ConcatenatingArrowStreamReader class for reading and concatenating multiple Arrow IPC streams within Spark, handling schema validation, message iteration, and cloning for non-destructive reads.

classes.name: ConcatenatingArrowStreamReader
classes.description: A class that concatenates multiple Arrow message streams, ensuring schema consistency and supporting non-destructive message cloning.

classes.name: AbstractMessageIterator
classes.description: A trait defining an iterator over ArrowMessages with schema and bytesRead properties.

classes.name: MessageIterator
classes.description: An iterator that decodes an Arrow IPC stream into individual messages, reading from an InputStream.

methods.name: readSchema
methods.description: Reads and returns the schema from the first message in the stream.

methods.name: nextMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the next ArrowMessage from the current iterator, switching to the next iterator if needed.

methods.name: loadNextBatch
methods.description: Loads the next batch of data, handling record and dictionary batches.

methods.name: cloneIfNonDestructive
methods.description: Clones the batch if in non-destructive mode; otherwise, returns the original.

methods.name: cloneRecordBatch
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an ArrowRecordBatch.

methods.name: bytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes read so far.
